recaps.storyRecap: November 6, 1983, in Hawkins, Indiana. After an evening playing Dungeons & Dragons, 12-year-old Will Byers vanishes into thin air while cycling home near the top-secret Hawkins National Laboratory. The next morning, his distraught mother Joyce demands Police Chief Jim Hopper launch a manhunt. Meanwhile, Will's friends Mike, Dustin, and Lucas sneak into Mirkwood forest to search for him, only to stumble upon a terrified girl with a shaved head and hospital gown.

recaps.storyRecap: The gargantuan Season 4 finale! The Hawkins squad launches a synchronized four-phase strike on Vecna. While Max volunteers as psychic bait at the Creel House, Steve, Nancy, and Robin infiltrate the Upside Down with shotguns and Molotov cocktails. In Nevada, Eleven projects her consciousness across 2,000 miles to battle Vecna inside Max's mind. Though Vecna is wounded and pushed back, the four massive gates rip through Hawkins, plunging the town into apocalyptic smoke.
